audience: support agents and support managers who handle tickets in Zendesk

useCases.title: Find tickets with Zendesk search
useCases.text: The AI searches tickets, users and organizations with Zendesk search syntax, such as open tickets of one organization. You can also run a saved view.

useCases.title: Read a ticket with its comments
useCases.text: The AI opens a ticket and lists its public replies and internal notes, oldest first. It can sum up the conversation.

useCases.title: Check response and resolution times of a ticket
useCases.text: The AI reads SLA, response and resolution time metrics for a ticket. You see whether it met its targets.

useCases.title: Find customers who gave a low satisfaction rating
useCases.text: The AI lists satisfaction (CSAT) ratings, filtered by score, with the tickets behind them. You see where customers were unhappy.

useCases.title: Create a ticket, reply or update a ticket
useCases.text: The AI creates a ticket, adds a public reply or an internal note, or changes the status, priority, assignee, group or tags of a ticket.
